property_summary: For any admissible signed order, fillOrder must succeed (it mints the maker position at uint256(orderHash) and the caller's opposite position at a different id); the mutant mints the caller at the already-minted orderHash id, so every fillOrder call reverts with ALREADY_MINTED.
change_summary: Set positionId to uint256(orderHash) instead of uint256(oppositeOrderHash), changing the returned value.
